mapper.sql: m.id, m.family_id, m.husband_id, m.wife_id, m.marriage_order, m.marry_date, m.divorce_date, m.status, m.is_primary, m.note, m.create_time, m.update_time, h.name AS husband_name, w.name AS wife_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marriage m INNER JOIN person h ON h.id = m.husband_id INNER JOIN person w ON w.id = m.wife_id WHERE m.family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY m.marriage_order ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT FROM marriage m INNER JOIN person h ON h.id = m.husband_id INNER JOIN person w ON w.id = m.wife_id WHERE m.husband_id = #{personId} OR m.wife_id = #{personId} ORDER BY m.marriage_order ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT FROM marriage m INNER JOIN person h ON h.id = m.husband_id INNER JOIN person w ON w.id = m.wife_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marriage (family_id, husband_id, wife_id, marriage_order, marry_date, divorce_date, status, is_primary, note) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{husbandId}, #{wifeId}, #{marriageOrder}, #{marryDate}, #{divorceDate}, #{status}, #{isPrimary}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE marriage SET family_id = #{familyId}, husband_id = #{husbandId}, wife_id = #{wifeId}, marriage_order = #{marriageOrder}, marry_date = #{marryDate}, divorce_date = #{divorceDate}, status = #{status}, is_primary = #{isPrimary}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id}
